question: Who was awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2024 for becoming the youngest World Chess Champion in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gukesh D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Gukesh D**, an Indian chess prodigy, became the **youngest World Chess Champion** in January 2025.
 
• He is the youngest Indian player to achieve a FIDE rating of 2700+, a milestone in chess excellence.
 
• In recognition of his extraordinary achievements, Gukesh D was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2024**,
